case.question: I fish for salmon from a boat. For this week, how good do you expect boat fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Grand Haven: 3 (good).** My first choice. Run boat lines 50 to 90 feet down over 100 to 160 feet of water.
- **Muskegon: 3 (good).** Essentially tied with Grand Haven. Fish 60 to 100 feet down over 100 to 160 feet of water.
- **South Haven: 2 (average).** Chinook were the main catch and fished well on spoons and meat rigs, but coho were weak. Fish about 95 to 115 feet of water.
- **St. Joseph: 1 (below average).** The recent reports were the weakest of the four.
- **Lures for the north ports:** glow spoons, meat rigs, and white flasher/fly or green rotator combinations.

## Why

- **Grand Haven and Muskegon are my picks:** the newest reports, from July 30, rated boat fishing good at both ports, with fish in 100 to 160 feet of water.
- **South Haven is behind because coho were weak:** the July 30 Chinook bite was good, but the coho bite was rated below average.
- **St. Joseph is last because its trend is down:** its last three reports went from below average to slow to average, and the July 30 report was the only one above slow.
- **I'd expect the sharp cooling to help the north ports:** the Grand Haven and Muskegon buoy fell 14 F in the week before today, and I'd expect cold water to hold fish near the 50 to 90 foot range.

## Evidence

**Recent reports** (newest is 2025-07-30, six days old)
- Grand Haven, 2025-07-30: "Boat anglers found good numbers of salmon in 100 to 160 feet of water… Glow plugs, meat rigs, and rotator/fly combinations worked best 50 to 90 feet down." Rated 3.
- Muskegon, 2025-07-30: "The best action was 60 to 100 feet down in 100 to 160 feet of water… glow plugs, glow spoons, green rotator/fly combinations, and meat rigs all worked well." Rated 3.
- South Haven, 2025-07-30: Chinook rated 3 ("most successful fishing occurred around 95 feet of water… predominantly on spoons"). Coho rated 1.
- St. Joseph, 2025-07-30: "Salmon fishing was decent… anglers targeted waters from 90 to well beyond 110 feet. Rotators tipped with flies or meat rigs proved to be the most productive." Rated 2.
- Earlier, 2025-07-23: Grand Haven was rated 3 and Muskegon 2. South Haven was rated 0 ("very scattered," "on the slow side") and St. Joseph 0 ("a little slow").

**Past seasons** (similar buoy temperature, about 67 F, within two weeks of today)
- Muskegon, 2023-08-16, a week with a sharp cooling: boat anglers rated good on glow plugs and glow spoons in 50 to 120 feet of water.
- Grand Haven, 2023-08-16, the same kind of week: boat anglers rated good, with the best action 40 to 90 feet down in 70 to 150 feet of water.
- St. Joseph, 2023-08-16, same kind of week: boat fishing was limited to fish inside 80 feet and rated 1.

**Conditions now** (buoy readings for the week before today, measured; the tool was in backtest mode, so these are not live readings)
- Grand Haven and Muskegon (buoy 45161): averaged 67 F, down 14 F over the week, a possible upwelling.
- South Haven (buoy 45168): averaged 65 F, down 9 F, a possible upwelling.
- St. Joseph (buoy 45026): averaged 69 F, down 4 F, a possible upwelling.
- General guidance (Michigan Sea Grant / MSU Extension): upwelling brings cold water and salmon toward shore, and mature Chinook in early fall often hold in water of 55 F or less.

## Caveats

- **The newest report is six days old** and was written when the buoys read 75 to 77 F. The cooling since then is the main unknown.
- **No live wind forecast or modeled cold-layer depth came back**, so I can't say how the lake will look this week or whether the boat ride will be safe.
- **The ratings are my judgment**, based on a few reports per port. South Haven and St. Joseph in particular rest on thin evidence.
- **The historical weeks are a guide only.** They suggest the cooling could help, but I'd expect fish to shift depth quickly.

## Sources

- Jul 30, 2025 (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3ebb776
- Jul 23, 2025 (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/3eab77c
- Aug 16, 2023 (historical, Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/36b27d5
